rows.title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
rows.snippet: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.
rows.source_excerpt: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
rows.translated_excerpt: 9 月劳动力市场走弱，新增就业仅 29,000 人，失业率升至 4.2%

rows.title: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
rows.snippet: Odds tumbled after a jobs report showed a soft labor market, leading more traders to lower the the chances of a fed funds rate increase this month.
rows.source_excerpt: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
rows.translated_excerpt: 疲弱的就业报告公布后，交易员目前认为美联储 10 月加息的可能性很小

rows.title: EM Assets Find Relief as US Jobs Data Eases Rate Fears
rows.snippet: An index tracking emerging-market currencies climbed to a session high after weaker-than-expected US jobs data prompted traders to scale back bets on another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday. The figure missed all estimates in a Bloomberg survey of economists. For more, we speak with Anisha Goodly, Fixed Income Managing Director at TCW. (Source: Bloomberg)
rows.source_excerpt: Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday.
rows.translated_excerpt: 美国劳工统计局周五公布的数据显示，9 月非农就业人数增加 29,000 人，此前两个月的数据被下修。

rows.title: Former CEA Chair on Jobs Report, GDP Growth
rows.snippet: Former CEA Chair Cecilia Rouse believes that we may be 'entering a new normal' of the jobs report, with the break even potentially settling in around 50,000. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
rows.source_excerpt: Former CEA Chair on Jobs Report, GDP Growth
rows.translated_excerpt: 前 CEA 主席谈就业报告与 GDP 增长

rows.title: Former Labor Secretary Rob Reich on Sept. Jobs Report
rows.snippet: Robert Reich, former US Labor Secretary, discusses persistent inflation, very slow hiring, and wages that trail prices. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
rows.source_excerpt: Former Labor Secretary Rob Reich on Sept. Jobs Report
rows.translated_excerpt: 前劳工部长 Rob Reich 谈 9 月就业报告

rows.title: CEA Chairman: Inflation coming down sufficiently fast
rows.snippet: Chris Phelan CEA Chairman, sees inflation clearly easing and thinks it's doing so quickly enough. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
rows.source_excerpt: CEA Chairman: Inflation coming down sufficiently fast
rows.translated_excerpt: CEA 主席：通胀正以足够快的速度回落

rows.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
rows.snippet: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.
rows.source_excerpt: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
rows.translated_excerpt: G7 国家将释放柴油储备，因欧洲和中东的战争制约了燃料供应

rows.title: Wall Street Tries to Live With 5% Yields as Market Cracks Grow
rows.snippet: Wall Street has spent weeks trying to make peace with the great bond selloff. Friday offered some short-lived relief — along with a warning about the damage from stubbornly high yields across investment strategies of all stripes.
rows.source_excerpt: Wall Street has spent weeks trying to make peace with the great bond selloff. Friday offered some short-lived relief — along with a warning about the damage from stubbornly high yields across investment strategies of all stripes.
rows.translated_excerpt: 华尔街数周来一直在逐渐适应这场大规模债券抛售。周五带来了一些短暂的缓解——同时也警告称，居高不下的收益率正对各类投资策略造成损害。
